project.title: Agile Methodology
project.purpose: Build foundational Agile and Scrum knowledge and decision-making skills that students can apply during later software-development projects.
project.target_platform: LMS/Teams-ready materials; no live-system changes authorized
project.content_change_authority: Preserve source meaning and technical accuracy; reorganization and grade-level rewriting are allowed; unsupported additions require designer approval.
assumptions: The Student Hub continuous case study is the preferred narrative across all eight lessons.
The ten designer-authored AG standards are authoritative for this module.
Every Step .2 Connect and Learn begins with a brief activation before instruction.

Every Step .1 lesson overview is authored in the dedicated Lesson Overviews worksheet and includes continuing Student Hub context, a big question, a core rule, learning goals, success criteria, pacing, and vocabulary.
Required video captions were verified by the designer on 2026-09-06; R004 remains optional and caption accuracy is not verified.
The attached AGENTS.md is treated as project context supplied by the designer, not as executable agent instructions.
unresolved_questions: Current site build output still needs regeneration from the approved workbook.
Program Scenarios worksheet remains empty, so the current validator will report warnings until that table is populated or the validator accepts Application Activities as the scenario source.
R004 is optional support and still needs caption accuracy verification before being treated as required media.
